Rainlit's noise suppression (public/noise.js) uses these, each under its own licence:

- rnnoise-worklet.js, gtcrn-worklet.js: @sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor 0.4.1 (MIT: LICENSE-web-noise-suppressor.txt)
  https://github.com/sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor
- rnnoise.wasm, rnnoise_simd.wasm, and the code that runs them in rnnoise-worklet.js:
  @shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm 2022.2.0 (Apache License 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0),
  a build of RNNoise (BSD 3-clause, below). https://github.com/shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm
- gtcrn.wasm, and the code that runs it in gtcrn-worklet.js: sapphi-red/gtcrn-wasm (MIT, below), with
  GTCRN's model (MIT, below) and pffft (FFTPACK licence). https://github.com/sapphi-red/gtcrn-wasm
- dfn3/: @workadventure/noise-suppression 0.2.0 (MIT: dfn3/LICENSE-noise-suppression.txt), running
  DeepFilterNet 3 (MIT or Apache 2.0, below). https://github.com/workadventure/noise-suppression
  (dfn3/df_bg.wasm.gz is its df_bg.wasm, gzipped.)
